technical_summary: SignalForge is a code-search and internal docs platform used by 1.2k engineers. Current corpus ~50M code snippets + 8M docs (avg text length 120 tokens). They compute 1536-d embeddings with nightly updates for active repos and a full reindex weekly. Production workload: bursty traffic from CI hooks and developer queries, typical sustained 150-250 qps with peak spikes to 500 qps. Current stack: in-house FAISS cluster + a small learned reranker (cross-encoder) that runs on CPU. Pain points: reindex job time (12-36h), high tail latency during reindexing, lack of predictable cost model for dense retrieval + reranking. Must support SSO/SAML, enterprise audit logs, and EU data residency for specific customers.
cost_targets: Target: <$0.003 per query at 200 qps after batching and caching. Internal threshold: <$0.01/query for proof-of-concept. Annual budget for infra/component expected in $150k-500k ARR band depending on deployment mode.
